categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing, processing, and sales of automotive and motorcycle parts, including lighting equipment, engine parts, body parts, and electronic components. It also produces aircraft and marine parts, traffic machinery, and plastic injection molded products. The business includes import-export trade and agency sales of related products. Automotive products constitute about 91% of revenue, motorcycles about 3.7%, and others 5.3%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced automotive lighting systems such as LED, adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS), and intelligent interactive lighting designs. The company employs modular design, optical design with multi-layer lenses, precision mold manufacturing, and integration of electronic control systems including CAN/LIN bus communication. Production methods involve plastic injection molding, assembly, and quality control adhering to international standards like ISO 26262 and IATF 16949.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves automotive manufacturers (OEM) and the automotive aftermarket (AM) globally, with a strong focus on North America and Europe. Key customers include major car manufacturers requiring high-quality certified lighting products. The aftermarket segment is driven by vehicle aging and replacement demand. The company also targets emerging electric vehicle manufacturers primarily in Europe and the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major sales markets in the United States, the Netherlands, Europe, and Asia. It has production facilities and subsidiaries in Taiwan, China (Changzhou, Kunshan), Thailand, Vietnam, and the US. The export ratio is over 93%, with significant sales in North America and Europe. The company is expanding distribution and production capabilities in Southeast Asia and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing and assembling automotive lighting and related components. It sources raw materials such as plastics, metals, and electronic parts from suppliers and delivers finished products to OEMs and aftermarket distributors. It also engages in product design and development, integrating upstream materials with downstream vehicle assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product certifications, accelerating new product development, and enhancing intelligent lighting technologies such as digital control HIAS headlamp systems and modular optical-electro-thermal designs. The company focuses on innovation in LED lighting, adaptive lighting systems, and smart interactive lighting to maintain technological leadership. R&D investments are increasing, with plans to develop hidden lighting and wide-angle micro-pupil concentrators.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive and motorcycle parts, including lighting systems and electronic components. The company also earns from OEM contracts and aftermarket product sales. It leverages global distribution networks and strategic alliances to increase sales volume and market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading global supplier of automotive lighting and safety components, competing on quality, innovation, and certification compliance. It faces competition from global automotive lighting manufacturers, especially from low-cost producers in China, India, and Eastern Europe. The company differentiates through advanced technology, extensive certifications, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately NT$20.1 billion in the latest fiscal year, showing a 4.38% growth over the prior year. Operating profit increased by 34.56%, and net profit after tax grew by 37.79%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 61.5% and a return on equity of 15.93%. It continues to invest in capital expenditures and R&D to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, certified automotive lighting products with advanced optical and electronic technologies. Its value proposition includes innovative smart lighting solutions that enhance driving safety and aesthetics, modular and lightweight designs, and compliance with stringent international standards. The company also offers comprehensive global distribution and customer service, aiming to be a one-stop shop for automotive lighting and safety components.
